_doc: W5 w1b body anchored-image bbox oracle. Recorded once from the native Hancom-authored PDF (examples/hwp5_review/floating_image_not_treat_as_char.pdf, untracked review asset) so the ±0.1pt gate is CI-durable without committing the 1.1MB PDF. hwpx_sha256 guards fixture drift; hancom_pdf_sha256 pins the source of the recorded numbers. Bbox is page-space top-left pt (support::extract_pages). Only the positive-vert-offset / first-paragraph / zero-horz-offset axis is oracle-validated by this fixture — see the epic doc §9e for the deferred (w2) axes.
